definition: The task of converting images of typed, handwritten, or printed text into machine-readable text.
details: OCR is a foundational technology for digitizing documents and is increasingly integrated into multimodal LLM pipelines that need to extract text from scanned documents, screenshots, or photos.
story: Imagine an art restorer who can spot a single cracked tile in a vast mosaic. Think of it this way: The task of converting images of typed, handwritten, or printed text into machine-readable text. And here is the clever part: OCR is a foundational technology for digitizing documents and is increasingly integrated into multimodal LLM pipelines that need to extract text from scanned documents, screenshots, or photos. The model looks the way you look at a crowd and finds the one face you know. And that is Optical Character Recognition — giving a machine the gift of sight.
